question: emotional-monologue
prompt: I stood at the edge of the world today. Not metaphorically — literally. The ground ended, and beyond it was nothing but sky. And for the first time in my life, I understood what it meant to be truly free. Not free from something. Free for something. The wind didn't push me forward or pull me back. It just... held me there, like a friend who knows when not to speak.
